step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture illustrates Megazone Cloud's Cloud Flex Media SaaS platform on AWS. API Gateway serves as the REST API entry point for control operations, passing requests to Lambda functions. For VOD transcoding, Step Functions orchestrates a series of specialized Lambda functions and triggers MediaConvert. For live streaming and channel scheduling, Fargate containers update input schedules for MediaLive, which outputs video streams to MediaPackage. For AI-driven features, Transcribe converts speech to text, passing the generated transcript to Translate for multi-language video subtitles, while Rekognition analyzes media to automatically generate metadata and detect explicit content or specific figures.

graph.name: Megazone Cloud - Cloud Flex Media Architecture
graph.notes: Cloud Flex Media is an end-to-end media platform providing REST APIs via API Gateway, VOD transcoding pipelines via Step Functions and MediaConvert, scheduled and real-time live broadcasting via Fargate and MediaLive/MediaPackage, and AI features using Transcribe, Translate, and Rekognition.

nodes.name: API GW
nodes.notes: Exposes REST APIs for management console, uploading, transcoding, scheduling, analysis, and stats.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Executes backend API logic and request processing.

nodes.name: Step Functions Lambdas
nodes.notes: Grouped Lambda functions executing tasks like media metadata retrieval, transcode preparation, and composition.

nodes.name: FARGATE
nodes.notes: Runs containerized service that updates channel input schedules for scheduled live broadcasts.

nodes.name: MEDIA LIVE
nodes.notes: Processes real-time RTMP inputs and scheduled VOD live broadcasts.

nodes.name: MEDIA PACKAGE
nodes.notes: Packages live streams for delivery to consumers.

nodes.name: TRANSCRIBE
nodes.notes: Converts audio/speech from video content into text.

nodes.name: TRANSLATE
nodes.notes: Translates transcribed text into multiple languages for subtitles.

nodes.name: REKOGNITION
nodes.notes: Detects labels, explicit content, and specific persons in video frames for auto metadata creation.

edges.notes: API Gateway triggers backend Lambda functions upon REST API calls.
Step Functions orchestrates execution across multiple functional Lambda tasks.
Step Functions workflow invokes MediaConvert for video transcoding.
Fargate application updates input schedule of MediaLive channels.
MediaLive outputs encoded live streams to MediaPackage.
Transcribed text output is passed to Translate for multi-language subtitle generation.
